intro h
split
· intro hxy
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqy⟩ := ArchimedeanClass.mk_le_mk_iff_exists_q.1 hxy
  exact ⟨q, hq, mul_le_mul_right hqy (le_refl |x|)⟩

· intro H
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqy⟩ := H
  have : f q * |y| ≤ |x| := hqy
  have : 0 < f q := hq
  rw [ArchimedeanClass.mk_le_mk_iff_exists_q] at h
  exact h ⟨q, hq, hqy⟩
